essential_scientific_results: Theorem 8.3 implements each fixed finite admitted quantum measurement programme using a common autonomous semibounded nonrelativistic Schrödinger model, Bohmian positions, complete initial quantum equilibrium, and finite input-independent ready stock.

Exact forced harmonic pointer motion gives rho_t=p0*g_sigma(y)+p1*g_sigma(y-b(t)), j_t=p1*b_dot*g_sigma(y-b(t)), and Y_t=F_t^{-1}(U). False-ready, positive-time crossing, and null probabilities are explicit.

Pointwise zero archive current under retained orthogonal keys makes old actual records stationary while later source gates may fail to commute with earlier measurements. Copy mismatch pays both classifier tails. Covariant SWAP transports the controlling trap and retains reset receivers.

Massive-clock comparison in W0 and W2 norms preserves clock, reference, keys, fuel and receivers. At sc=sqrt(hbar*T/(2*Mc)), fixed-apparatus error scales as Mc^(-1/2). W2 trace estimates bound absolute current through chosen archive surfaces.

E_out=min(1,epsilon_0+epsilon_gate+sum_j sqrt(2 delta_j)) bounds retained-output trace distance or half-diamond distance. E_hist<=min(1,E_out+E_arch+E_transfer) controls joint earlier declarations and whole routed symbolic holds.

Initial equilibrium is an explicit input. Reliable records do not uniquely select Bohmian guidance: an equivariant diffusion has identical equilibrium density and current, can have arbitrarily reliable finite records, yet microscopic path TV distance one.

Fixed finite programme and horizon first, then finite choices at each positive tolerance. Gaussian finite moments do not imply compact support or hard energy cutoff.
